text:
Hi,

I'm thinking of renting the Orsini Veloce for a weekend getaway, and I'm hoping it'll be a great choice for us. We're planning to pick it up on April 6, 2027 at 12.00pm and bring it back on Wednesday 7 April 2027 at 6:00 pm. I'll be collecting it from your garage, by the way - I've been meaning to find out how you keep your place so tidy. I've attached my driving licence for your reference. 

Cheers,
Victor Braithwell
